Village Pub and Cafe
Dear valued guests,
Thank you for coming and having some food in our family restaurant.
We are so sorry for your bad experience.
I would like to explain as follows:
This year is a difficult time for us, Our staff was off and we were sometimes busy because of our children. 
We serve local and fresh foods and drinks, so it takes time, especially when we have many guests at the same time.
We always try our best to make things as good as possible.
Hopefully you understand for us
Thank you very much
Warmest regards,
Quan Tran

Cafe with authentic Vietnamese
Dec 2024 • Family
